units.title: Corporate application foundation
units.scope: Create thin organization profile, exact-share units, policy fixtures, canonical registry and engine consumer contracts.
acceptanceCriteria: Share-weight default, private mode and anchoring-off default are executable without copying engine internals.
requiredTests: Profile, unsafe-share input, dependency and shared registry tests.

units.title: Organization rooms and private engine integration
units.scope: Build board/committee/shareholder rooms and integrate engine identity, encrypted collaboration, editor and shared admin.
acceptanceCriteria: Each room has explicit authorized recipients; corporate content does not appear in public discovery or provider logs.
requiredTests: Consumer contract, cross-organization, device authorization and private rendering tests.

units.title: Entity rules and governing instrument profiles
units.scope: Model corporation/LLC/cooperative profiles, bylaws, reserved matters, board vs member capacity and configurable governing rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Rules identify source/authority and do not claim a jurisdiction-complete legal validity check.
requiredTests: Profile goldens, unauthorized override, source-version migration and rollback tests.

units.title: Share ledger, classes and record dates
units.scope: Import and reconcile authorized share records, fractional fixed-point units, classes, voting multipliers, beneficial-owner references and record-date snapshots.
acceptanceCriteria: Transfers after the record date do not change active ballots; ownership does not automatically imply equal voting rights across classes.
requiredTests: Large/fractional quantities, duplicate owner imports, rounding denial, transfers, mixed classes and reconciliation fixtures.

units.title: Director, shareholder and proxy authority
units.scope: Implement authenticated proxies, custodian/beneficial-owner attribution, revocation, direct-vote precedence, expiry and delegated signatory capacity.
acceptanceCriteria: A principal entitlement can be exercised only once; delegation cycles and over-allocation fail; staff roles cannot forge ownership.
requiredTests: Proxy/direct race, cycle, revocation at cutoff, split allocation, forged authority and double-count tests.

units.title: Selective clause unlock and confidential electorate
units.scope: Open selected clauses to selected classes or committees with read/propose/discuss/vote rights and timed expirations; keep remaining text restricted.
acceptanceCriteria: Nested amendments, redlines, references and exports cannot reveal or mutate locked clauses.
requiredTests: Section capability matrix, expired unlock, hidden-reference leakage and multi-clause proposal tests.

units.title: Corporate quorum and multi-class resolutions
units.scope: Configure quorum by represented shares or heads, approval by eligible/cast/present weight, class vetoes, supermajorities, abstentions and broker/nonvotes where applicable.
acceptanceCriteria: Overall approval never bypasses a required class approval; every denominator is named and reproducible; Board votes can use equal-person profiles.
requiredTests: Boundary matrices, record-date share exactness, class failures, ties, nonvote categories and mixed-electorate tests.

units.title: Meetings, written consents and reserved matters
units.scope: Add notices, agendas, meeting/written-consent decisions, submission/seconding options, attachments, effective dates and board/member sequencing.
acceptanceCriteria: Decision records preserve delivery/notice and required class/board/member stages under the configured rule profile.
requiredTests: Notice deadline, missing prerequisite, staged approvals, duplicate meeting close and state-transition tests.

units.title: Conflicts, recusals and sensitive disclosures
units.scope: Model interests, recusals, exclusion rules, designated confidential counsel access and evidence retention without promising privilege by software alone.
acceptanceCriteria: Recused weight is treated under the disclosed policy; changed eligibility requires a fresh snapshot or explicit procedure.
requiredTests: Conflict leak, weight denominator, recusal changes, unauthorized counsel access and retention tests.

units.title: Execution signatures, minutes and closing packages
units.scope: Tailor execution capacity, corporate seals if configured, signature order, evidence certificates, resolutions, minute books and document bundles.
acceptanceCriteria: A vote is distinct from execution; signer capacity and exact frozen bytes are recorded; later signature appendices cannot alter signed text.
requiredTests: Wrong-capacity signer, changed PDF, partial execution, cancellation, mass-consent appendix and independent package verification tests.

units.title: Audit, retention, legal hold and portability
units.scope: Add retention schedules, legal holds, access logs, encrypted archives, export boundaries, account offboarding and optional organizational anchoring.
acceptanceCriteria: Legal holds prevent destruction under policy; anchoring stays off unless explicitly enabled; exported private data has a defined recipient/key boundary.
requiredTests: Hold/delete conflict, removed-member access, key-loss/restore, metadata leak and cross-tenant export tests.

units.title: Enterprise identity, billing and integrations
units.scope: Integrate SSO/SCIM, licensed seat/organization billing, cap-table provider adapters, scoped webhooks and optional e-sign provider adapters.
acceptanceCriteria: Providers cannot directly change frozen ownership snapshots or votes; webhooks are signed/idempotent; enterprise grants use shared entitlements.
requiredTests: SSO audience, SCIM deprovision, forged webhook, cap-table mismatch, provider retry and billing reconciliation tests.

units.title: Corporate unified admin and role walkthroughs
units.scope: Expose governed parameters and change simulation for secretary, director, shareholder and counsel roles with anchored tutorials and reproducible reports.
acceptanceCriteria: Secretary can preview a resolution before opening it; shareholder tour shows only actual unlocked clauses and their frozen vote weight.
requiredTests: Role matrix, active-ballot rule-change denial, mobile/keyboard tour, weighted report and admin audit tests.

units.title: Corporate production release and recovery
units.scope: Deploy isolated corporate configuration/frontend, execute real record-date proxy/class-approval and signing journeys and publish evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Verified private multiuser resolution lifecycle, immutable execution artifacts and restore/reconciliation pass on actual deployed commit.
requiredTests: Current-head full gates, E2EE canaries, cross-tenant browser smoke, load/restore and exact artifact verification; human review follows deployment.
